news.headline: Delhi Customs destroys 165 kg of seized narcotics worth ₹515 crore at incinerator facility
news.story_lead: The Delhi Customs department has successfully destroyed approximately 165 kg of confiscated narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances valued at about ₹515 crore. The operation was carried out at a designated incineration facility in Delhi in strict compliance with statutory protocols. This disposal underscores the ongoing enforcement measures against illicit drug trafficking and supports national initiatives like the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan.
news.full_article_text:
The Drug Disposal Committee of Delhi Customs oversaw the destruction of approximately 165 kg of seized narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances (NDPS) with an estimated market value of ₹515 crore. The disposal procedure took place at the incineration plant operated by M/s Biotic Waste Solutions Private Limited in Delhi, adhering strictly to established statutory rules and environmental safeguards governing the elimination of confiscated contraband. 

The destroyed illicit consignment primarily consisted of roughly 140 kg of hydroponic weed, valued at around ₹140 crore, alongside 25 kg of high-grade cocaine valued at approximately ₹375 crore. The entire operation proceeded under the supervision of Shri Arvind Saran, Commissioner of Customs (Airport & General). The High-Level Drug Disposal Committee was spearheaded by Chairperson Shri Shankar Prasad Sarma, Additional Commissioner of Customs (Disposal), with Joint Commissioner Ms. Neetisha Verma and other customs officials in attendance.

Separately, operational data released by Delhi Customs highlights significant enforcement activity at the Indira Gandhi International (IGI) Airport during the financial year 2025-26, spanning from April to September 2026. During this timeframe, the department registered 89 distinct cases of drug seizures at the airport. These interdictions accounted for a cumulative seizure of approximately 611 kg of various narcotic substances, including hydroponic weed, heroin, and cocaine, leading to the arrest of 109 individuals involved in drug smuggling networks. Authorities emphasized that these sustained enforcement actions, high-value seizures, and prompt disposal mechanisms are vital components of India's broader strategy to curb substance abuse and align with the Government of India's 'Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan'.

news.headline: Indian Pilot Smit Machchhar Recovering in Abu Dhabi After Foiling Mid-Air Cockpit Attack on flydubai Flight
news.story_lead: Indian pilot Captain Smit Machchhar is making steady progress at a hospital in Abu Dhabi after surviving a violent mid-air attack by his co-pilot on a flydubai flight. The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) confirmed that Indian diplomatic missions are in constant contact with his family and medical teams to ensure his recovery.
news.full_article_text:
The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) of India has provided a positive health update on Captain Smit Machchhar, who is currently undergoing treatment in Abu Dhabi, UAE. MEA Official Spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated during a bi-weekly press briefing that the Indian Embassy in the UAE is maintaining regular communication with the pilot, his family, local authorities, and the hospital administration. Captain Machchhar was transferred to Abu Dhabi for advanced medical care after receiving initial treatment in Saudi Arabia. The Indian Embassy in the UAE also shared on social media platform X that the captain is making steady progress and regaining his health.

The medical emergency stems from a critical mid-air incident on September 30, 2026, aboard flydubai Flight FZ1073, which was operating from Dubai to Tel Aviv. During the flight, Omani co-pilot Hamam al-Hammami launched an attack on Captain Machchhar inside the cockpit using an axe in an attempt to crash the aircraft. Despite sustaining severe injuries, Captain Machchhar managed to unlock the cockpit door. This crucial action allowed off-duty crew members and passengers to enter, overpower the attacker, and secure the cockpit.

The violent struggle led to a rapid descent, with the aircraft plunging approximately 16,000 feet within a span of two minutes before a hijacking distress signal was successfully transmitted. The plane was safely diverted to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, where all 180 occupants landed without further injuries. Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke with Captain Machchhar via a video call to commend his bravery, presence of mind, and composure. During the emotional call, Captain Machchhar shared that he recited the Hanuman Chalisa during the crisis and expressed his deep gratitude to the Prime Minister.

hindi_translation.story_lead: फ्लाईदुबई विमान में अपने सह-पायलट द्वारा किए गए जानलेवा हमले में गंभीर रूप से घायल हुए भारतीय पायलट कैप्टन स्मित मछार अब अबू धाबी के एक अस्पताल में तेजी से स्वस्थ हो रहे हैं। विदेश मंत्रालय ने पुष्टि की है कि भारतीय राजनयिक लगातार उनके परिवार और डॉक्टरों के संपर्क में हैं।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
भारत के विदेश मंत्रालय (MEA) ने अबू धाबी, यूएई में उपचाराधीन कैप्टन स्मित मछार के स्वास्थ्य पर सकारात्मक जानकारी साझा की है। विदेश मंत्रालय के प्रवक्ता रणधीर जायसवाल ने एक प्रेस ब्रीफिंग में बताया कि यूएई में भारतीय दूतावास पायलट, उनके परिवार, स्थानीय अधिकारियों और अस्पताल प्रशासन के साथ लगातार संपर्क बनाए हुए है। सऊदी अरब में प्रारंभिक उपचार के बाद कैप्टन मछार को उन्नत चिकित्सा के लिए अबू धाबी स्थानांतरित किया गया था।

यह घटना 30 सितंबर 2026 को फ्लाईदुबई की उड़ान FZ1073 (दुबई से तेल अवीव) के दौरान हुई थी। उड़ान के दौरान, ओमानी सह-पायलट हम्माम अल-हमामी ने विमान को क्रैश करने के इरादे से कॉकपिट के भीतर कैप्टन मछार पर कुल्हाड़ी से हमला कर दिया था। गंभीर रूप से घायल होने के बावजूद, कैप्टन मछार ने कॉकपिट का दरवाजा खोलने में सफलता पाई, जिससे यात्रियों और ऑफ-ड्यूटी चालक दल के सदस्यों को अंदर आने और हमलावर को काबू करने का मौका मिला।

news.headline: Elon Musk accuses certain entities of blocking Starlink's entry into India through monopolistic barriers
news.story_lead: SpaceX founder Elon Musk has alleged that Starlink's commercial rollout in India is being hindered by certain domestic oligarchs maintaining a monopolistic chokehold. Meanwhile, senior Starlink executives confirmed that the company has established operations tailored to Indian security regulations and is awaiting final administrative nods.
news.full_article_text:
SpaceX founder and CEO Elon Musk publicly claimed that satellite internet provider Starlink is facing deliberate blockages in India by certain oligarchs aiming to preserve a monopolistic chokehold over the population. Responding to social media commentary regarding India's connectivity needs in underserved regions, Musk characterized the delay as a crime against the public. Despite securing a government license alongside competitors like Eutelsat OneWeb and Jio Satellite Communications, Starlink continues to await final spectrum allocations, security clearances, and foreign investment-related approvals before launching commercial services. The Department of Telecommunications (DoT) did not immediately respond to media inquiries regarding the matter.

Speaking at the India Mobile Congress in New Delhi, Lauren Dreyer, vice-president of Starlink Business Operations at SpaceX, stated that the company has structured its India setup specifically to comply with national security requirements and regulations. She noted that user data will be maintained domestically within India, and controls have been established at every operational layer. Starlink has already deployed 20 gateway sites consisting of hundreds of antennas and stands prepared to offer services once final clearances are granted. Furthermore, Starlink previously entered into a partnership in March 2025 with Bharti Airtel to explore selling equipment through Airtel stores, serving business clients, connecting rural institutions like schools and health centres, and utilizing Airtel's ground network infrastructure.
news.background_context: Starlink has been working with Indian regulators, operators, and industry stakeholders for five years and has obtained a government licence for satellite communication services alongside Eutelsat OneWeb and Jio Satellite Communications.

news.headline: Aaditya Thackeray Opposes Forced Shift of Flights to Navi Mumbai Airport Amid Terminal 1 Redevelopment Plans
news.story_lead: Shiv Sena (UBT) MLA Aaditya Thackeray has urged the Central government to intervene in the proposed redevelopment of Terminal 1 at Mumbai's Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport. He strongly opposed the airport operator's plan to force airlines and passengers to shift operations to the new Navi Mumbai International Airport, warning it could disrupt Mumbai's global connectivity.
news.full_article_text:
Adani Airport Holdings Ltd (AAHL), the operator of both Mumbai's Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (CSMIA) and the Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA), has requested airlines to relocate 33% of their international flights from CSMIA's Terminal 2 to NMIA or discontinue them by October 25. This proposal, aimed at facilitating the upcoming redevelopment of CSMIA's Terminal 1 (T1), has faced strong opposition from airlines and political leaders.

Shiv Sena (UBT) MLA Aaditya Thackeray has called on the Union Ministry of Civil Aviation to intervene, demanding that T1 be repaired, refurbished, or rebuilt without forcing flight relocations. Thackeray expressed concerns that the forced shift, combined with a lack of ground connectivity to the Navi Mumbai site, could lead to a multi-year closure of T1 and a permanent transfer of operations, ultimately harming Mumbai's international connectivity. He also criticized the current management for crowd handling issues and high commercial charges, such as parking fees.

In response to the growing friction, the Union Civil Aviation Ministry advised AAHL to postpone the partial flight transfer and initiate discussions to formulate a structured transition plan. According to AAHL, the redevelopment of T1 is scheduled to commence in January 2027. Once completed, the terminal's capacity is projected to expand by 33%, rising from the current 15 million passengers per annum (mppa) to 20 mppa. Currently, CSMIA operates with two terminals, where T1 handles domestic flights and T2 manages international operations.

hindi_translation.headline: टर्मिनल 1 के पुनर्विकास योजनाओं के बीच मुंबई से नवी मुंबई हवाई अड्डे पर उड़ानों के जबरन स्थानांतरण का आदित्य ठाकरे ने किया विरोध
hindi_translation.story_lead: शिवसेना (यूबीटी) विधायक आदित्य ठाकरे ने मुंबई के छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज अंतर्राष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डे के टर्मिनल 1 के प्रस्तावित पुनर्विकास में केंद्र सरकार से हस्तक्षेप करने का आग्रह किया है। उन्होंने हवाई अड्डा संचालक की उस योजना का कड़ा विरोध किया, जिसके तहत एयरलाइंस और यात्रियों को नए नवी मुंबई अंतर्राष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डे पर परिचालन स्थानांतरित करने के लिए मजबूर किया जा रहा है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
मुंबई के छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज अंतर्राष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डे (CSMIA) और नवी मुंबई अंतर्राष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डे (NMIA) दोनों का संचालन करने वाली कंपनी अडानी एयरपोर्ट होल्डिंग्स लिमिटेड (AAHL) ने एयरलाइंस से CSMIA के टर्मिनल 2 से अपनी 33% अंतर्राष्ट्रीय उड़ानों को NMIA में स्थानांतरित करने या 25 अक्टूबर तक उन्हें बंद करने को कहा है। CSMIA के टर्मिनल 1 (T1) के आगामी पुनर्विकास को सुगम बनाने के उद्देश्य से लाए गए इस प्रस्ताव का एयरलाइंस और राजनीतिक नेताओं द्वारा कड़ा विरोध किया जा रहा है।

शिवसेना (यूबीटी) विधायक आदित्य ठाकरे ने केंद्रीय नागरिक उड्डयन मंत्रालय से हस्तक्षेप करने की मांग की है। उन्होंने कहा कि उड़ानों को स्थानांतरित करने के लिए मजबूर किए बिना T1 की मरम्मत, नवीनीकरण या पुनर्निर्माण किया जाना चाहिए। ठाकरे ने चिंता व्यक्त की कि नवी मुंबई स्थल के लिए जमीनी संपर्क (ग्राउंड कनेक्टिविटी) की कमी के साथ उड़ानों का जबरन स्थानांतरण T1 को कई वर्षों के लिए बंद कर सकता है और अंततः मुंबई की वैश्विक कनेक्टिविटी को नुकसान पहुंचा सकता है। उन्होंने भीड़ प्रबंधन के मुद्दों और पार्किंग शुल्क जैसे उच्च व्यावसायिक शुल्कों के लिए वर्तमान प्रबंधन की भी आलोचना की।

इस बढ़ते विवाद के जवाब में, केंद्रीय नागरिक उड्डयन मंत्रालय ने AAHL को उड़ानों के आंशिक स्थानांतरण को स्थगित करने और एक व्यवस्थित संक्रमण योजना तैयार करने के लिए चर्चा शुरू करने की सलाह दी है। AAHL के अनुसार, T1 का पुनर्विकास जनवरी 2027 में शुरू होना निर्धारित है। पूरा होने के बाद, टर्मिनल की क्षमता 33% बढ़ने की उम्मीद है, जो वर्तमान 15 मिलियन यात्री प्रति वर्ष (mppa) से बढ़कर 20 mppa हो जाएगी। वर्तमान में, CSMIA दो टर्मिनलों के साथ काम करता है, जहां T1 घरेलू उड़ानों को संभालता है और T2 अंतर्राष्ट्रीय परिचालन का प्रबंधन करता है।
